_doc: OpenBuilds C-Beam 40x80 Linear Rail: an 80 x 40 mm C, six cells of 20 mm, with a channel 40 wide and 20 deep between its arms for a lead screw and a gantry, in 6063 T-5 aluminium, anodised clear or black. The size, the slot's opening and width, the bore and the pitch of the cells are printed on OpenBuilds' drawing; it publishes no area, second moments or mass that this build could read, so a beam's figures are worked out from the drawn outline. OpenBuilds shares its design work under CC BY-SA 4.0: dimensions are taken, the shape is not. The drawn outline leaves out the small V marks on the cores and the true corners of the hollows; the two hollows beside the uprights have a shape of their own on the drawing, and are drawn here as the others.
